source: assets/high-res/final-native2k. Those files were not modified.
requirement: One subject, floor backdrop and captions removed, feet hooves or wheels not cut.

meetsNotes.troop-bronze-ranged: Title plaque removed. One archer remains, boots included.
meetsNotes.troop-gunpowder-melee: Figure is intact. The light floor band is gone. A small contact shadow remains.
meetsNotes.troop-gunpowder-heavy: Cool cobble plane below y=900 is gone. Cannon, carriage, and wheels stay. A small blue shadow remains beside the cart wheel.
meetsNotes.troop-modern-melee: The detached rifle icon is removed.
meetsNotes.troop-future-melee: The grid floor is gone. Boots remain. A small contact shadow remains.
meetsNotes.troop-future-ranged: Standing soldier kept. Neighbor rectangle at x>=1248, y 652-778 is gone (0 opaque pixels there). Helmet top is y=176, not cropped. A ground shadow remains under the boots.
meetsNotes.hero-mount-horse: Hooves remain. Filled grey plane is gone. A thin outline remains.

improvedNotClean.troop-modern-ranged: One prone sniper remains. Snow under the body remains. A looser snow key was not shipped because it did not clear the snow without touching the body.
improvedNotClean.troop-industrial-ranged: Loose rifle dropped. Painted content is still prone, with the rifle in his hands, a sandbag, and a pink smear under the body. It is not a standing actor.
improvedNotClean.hero-mount-motor-transport: Wheels remain. Smooth ground below y=1550 was reduced. Grey ground on the left and a thin line remain.
improvedNotClean.hero-mount-future-transport: Pads and wheels remain. Some light ground was reduced. A pale ground sheet is still under the craft.
improvedNotClean.troop-future-heavy: Blue thrusters stay. The dark shadow under the hull remains. It was not removed.

doesNotMeet.troop-stone-melee: Boots and legs stay connected. Dirt around the boots matches the leather (luminance about 121 versus 122). A tighter polygon still kept that dirt, and a tighter cut started to shorten a sole. Residual dirt remains.
doesNotMeet.troop-stone-ranged: Boots stay. A low-chroma wood key below the shin line punched holes in the boot leather, so it was not shipped. The wooden platform and gravel remain.
